serving configs (bench-tune attempt-4: MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=256, mf 0.90, chunked 512, prefill 512, req 16)
note: Splitting into separate lm_eval invocations changes nothing per-request; MMLU and GPQA share the same loglikelihood machinery for the MC tasks.
